draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling's median latency was 41 ms per utterance versus 118 ms reported for Talmar, though the two were measured on different accelerators and precisions (Corvex A2 fp16 vs Corvex A1 fp32).
rationale: The numbers (41 vs 118 ms) match T1.r1.lat and T1.r2.lat. However, the latencies were measured under different conditions (Corvex A2 fp16 vs Corvex A1 fp32, and Talmar's value copied from its paper), so a direct "faster" comparison is not established. The sentence's hedge "may" is appropriate, but the comparison should note the differing measurement conditions.
